failure_mode: HTTP 410 Gone on every path and every version
root_cause: EBI retired the eQTL Catalogue REST API. /eqtl/api/, /eqtl/api/datasets, /eqtl/api/v1/datasets and /eqtl/api/v2/datasets all answer 410 with the body 'This API is no longer available. See the eQTL data access documentation: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/Data_access/'. That page now offers only FTP flat files, HDF5 and Tabix; there is no REST replacement to repoint at, unlike the GWAS Catalog whose deprecated summary-statistics API has /gwas/api/v2.
workaround: Bulk download from https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/spot/eQTL/ (tab-delimited and HDF5, with Tabix indexes for region queries), documented at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/Data_access/. For association lookups that only need a gene or variant, OpenTargets (opentargets_* tools) exposes eQTL evidence through its GraphQL API and remains live.
investigation_notes: Surfaced by the weekly tool health check: both eqtl tools returned status_code 410.
Probed v1, v2 and the unversioned path, plus /eqtl/api/ itself -- all 410.
ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/spot/eQTL/ returns 200, confirming the data moved rather than vanished.
